data.long_meaning: The name Greenman is a modern, spiritual name for a man associated with nature and the environment. It does not have a biblical or historical origin. The name Greenman carries the meaning “Man of the Green” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Greenman usually hope their child will grow to embody man of the green and live with faith, good character and purpose.
